## R Markdown

```{r}
df1 <- read.csv("/Users/deligkaris.1/OneDrive - The Ohio State University Wexner Medical Center/MICROSIM/PAPERS/EpilepsyCog/Cumulative_baseline_hazard_20251003-1.csv")
df50 <- read.csv("/Users/deligkaris.1/OneDrive - The Ohio State University Wexner Medical Center/MICROSIM/PAPERS/EpilepsyCog/Cumulative_baseline_hazard_20251003-50.csv")
head(df1)
head(df50)
```

```{r}
ggplot(df50, aes(x=time, y=hazard)) +
  geom_point()
```

```{r}
ggplot(df1, aes(x=time, y=hazard)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=hazard-1.96*standard.error, ymax=hazard+1.96*standard.error),
                #width=0.00002,
                color = "darkred",
                linewidth=0.02) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0,7)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.013))
```
```{r}
model <- lm(hazard ~ time + 0, data=df50|>filter(time<7))
summary(model)
```
```{r}
ggplot(df50, aes(x=time, y=hazard)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, #coef(model)[1], 
              slope= coef(model)[1], color = "darkred", linewidth=1) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0,7)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.013))
```
